## Activity

During January 2022, West Gate Eye Clinic completed 348 captures. This provides the activity total for the reporting period and records the volume of imaging undertaken at the site. The activity figure should be read alongside the image-quality and grading results below.

## Image quality

Image-quality review identified 12 ungradable captures. This represents an ungradable rate of 3.4% of all captures recorded during January 2022. The result indicates that most images were suitable for assessment, while the ungradable cases could not be used for grading.

## Grading

Grading identified 72 referable results. The median lag from capture to completion of grading was 17 days. These figures summarise the grading outcome and the time taken for images to progress through the review process during January 2022.

Staff raised no new equipment faults this month.
